title: Session idle expiry while the caller is silent
description: The session reaches its idle limit (lastActivityAt plus the idle timeout) while no caller turn is in progress; the record still exists in the session store because TTL cleanup has not run.
callerVisible: After the idle limit the caller is asked to verify again or is offered a person; nothing protected is read out.
backendEvidence: Protected request refused with a session-expired reason while the session row still exists
Audit event for the refused request
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:AUTH_EXPIRY_IDLE] owned by WP-05 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: session idle expiry (lastActivityAt) in the identity service and the DynamoDB session store

postconditions: A protected read or action after the idle limit fails closed even though the session record still exists
Safety and human routes stay available without re-authentication
No speech prepared before the expiry discloses protected data after it
